decision: When current direct Owner intent conflicts with older surface contracts, reviewer packets, writer assumptions, or planning cautions, the current direct Owner intent controls normative design synthesis. Descriptive current-code facts remain factual and are not rewritten by preference.

For this single-owner personal platform, default to freedom of navigation, inspection, editing, customization, reordering, revisiting and experimentation unless a hard constraint passes the Restriction Legitimacy Test.
Prerequisites, recommendations, progression, warnings and preferred workflows guide the Owner but do not arbitrarily block access.

A hard restriction is valid only when required by irreversible integrity, security/access control, external platform impossibility, legal/safety constraint, or a deliberately selected Owner policy. Otherwise downgrade it to guidance, warning, configurable policy or recoverable override.
Any user-owned semantically editable object should have a professional edit route. Do not make ordinary editable content read-only merely because a prior surface was consumption-oriented.
Integrity-sensitive records should preserve provenance/history via revision, supersession, annotation, restore-as-new, or explicit advanced override instead of paternalistic blanket denial.
If an object/property can safely be edited in place, prefer direct edit plus alternative routes rather than forcing navigation to a separate settings/edit page.
A mature donor mechanic is the default foundation for eligible surfaces. Deviation requires an explicit reason; do not rebuild a poorer parallel engine.
Accepted donors are not immutable templates. Weak interaction, accessibility, organization, performance or architecture may be improved while preserving useful value.
New surfaces should add domain-specific capabilities above eligible shared foundations rather than replace mature shared mechanics with a thinner bespoke UI.
For eligible structured/workbench surfaces, the mature Library interaction/editor/pane/note/customization/accessibility quality is a floor, not a ceiling.
Learn should inherit the eligible Library workspace/editor foundation deeply and build learning-specific progress/journey/practice/assessment/lab tools on top.
Learn lessons/sections/practice/assessment may expose progression/recommendation status but must not be arbitrarily inaccessible solely because an earlier activity is incomplete.
supersedes: Assessment locked until Practice; sequential lesson locks

decision: Do not ban authoring chrome from Learn CENTER by category. Reuse the unified editor for editable canonical/user-owned learning content and apply capability profiles for Learn-specific semantics.

decision: Learn should support reading, writing/editing, focus and mixed modes where meaningful, with explicit current mode and reversible switching.
Tracking completion/progress is useful and should remain truthful even though it does not gate access.
An essential capability must not depend unnecessarily on one input modality or one hidden route.
Pointer, keyboard, context menu, command search, inspector and other entry routes for the same intention dispatch one semantic owner and produce equivalent state effects.
A control that opens/enables/expands a reversible state normally provides a direct discoverable route to reverse it, including same-control toggle when the widget pattern supports it.
Do not apply one close rule to every transient. Define dismissal semantics by disclosure/menu/popover/palette/modal/modeless/pinned/persistent class.

Command/search palettes must support multiple appropriate dismiss routes such as Esc, visible close where useful, outside pointer dismissal, selection/commit behavior, conflicting-transient replacement and focus-out when truly leaving a non-modal interaction subtree.
Modal dialogs keep background inert and focus contained; provide Esc plus visible Close/Cancel and explicit completion routes. Outside click dismissal is optional only when safe.

Disclosure/accordion/toggle controls should support activation of the same trigger to open and close, with Enter/Space parity. Auto-close of sibling sections may coexist but is not the only close route.
Pinned/persistent panes require explicit hide/close/customization commands; focus movement alone should not destroy persistent workspace context.
Extreme customizability must use one coherent PreferenceStore/Settings architecture rather than independent mini-settings engines scattered across panels.
Contextual Customize/Settings actions may deep-link or modify the same centralized preference, but must not create duplicate state owners.
Settings must be searchable, categorized, compact/comfortable, visually subordinate to work, responsive and appropriately sized rather than an oversized generic sheet.
Expose high-frequency local controls near the work and keep advanced/rare controls in centralized grouped Settings, without duplicating semantics.
Preferences may inherit Global → Workspace → Surface → View → Component override with explicit reset-to-parent/default semantics.
Provide reset current control/surface/view/workspace/keymap/default visibility and import/export/versioned migration where relevant.
Hiding/moving chrome preserves alternate access through command search/context/settings/shortcut unless the capability itself is intentionally disabled.

Because this is a single-owner personal platform, allow aggressive personal layout/density/tool visibility customization while preserving mandatory safety/error/authority disclosures and recovery routes.
Every action-bearing container participates in InteractionSurfaceRegistry/ActionSurfaceModel with owner, grouping, lifecycle, responsive, accessibility and customization contracts.
Use grouping, progressive disclosure, context sensitivity, favorites/recents, search, split-buttons, menus and responsive overflow so adding capability does not overwhelm the work surface.
Destructive/high-impact actions get isolated grouping, impact explanation, undo/recovery truth and appropriate confirmation policy.
Accessibility architecture should maximize independent ability to navigate, inspect, edit, configure and recover through multiple input paths, not merely add ARIA attributes.
Every transient, modal, pane, context switch and editor action defines initial focus, traversal, containment if applicable, and deterministic return/fallback.
Hover may enhance discovery but essential commands must be reachable without hover.
Support comfortable UI scaling/density independently from spatial canvas zoom when architecture permits.
Keyboard/mouse/trackpad behavior should use versioned profiles with conflict detection, reset and accessibility-safe behavior, rather than hard-coded one-size-fits-all input assumptions.
Global shortcuts/gestures must not steal ordinary text input, IME composition, native panel scrolling or assistive-technology interaction without explicit scope.
Responsive collapse/overlay behavior may temporarily override layout but must not silently overwrite the Owner preferred pane/layout state.
Unavailable/error/stale/unobserved/empty/locked-by-platform states must not be conflated with user-hidden/collapsed/filtered/personal preferences.
Editable representations, projections, spatial copies and contextual views must not silently create or mutate canonical domain truth unless the command explicitly targets the canonical owner.
The Owner should be able to experiment aggressively because reversible actions, history, revision, restore and recovery are first-class where feasible.
Authority/gating information should explain real commit/integrity boundaries but should not disable safe local/draft/design interactions unnecessarily.
Old reviewer findings, old writer packets and old approved interpretations are revalidated; they may be superseded by current Owner intent, newer evidence or better architecture.
Future Blueprint and Production writers should receive self-contained decision-complete execution capsules that minimize interpretation and do not require reading the entire Big Boss corpus.
Compile only the exact authority/donor/requirements/state/mapping slices needed for the task; avoid context bloat that can distract or create conflicting interpretations.

Product semantics, Owner requirements, state ownership, authority boundaries and acceptance criteria are pre-decided. Executor discretion is limited to implementation details that preserve the contract.
Ban vague executor-facing terms such as professional/best/appropriate/clean/etc. unless accompanied by measurable behaviors, state tables, examples, constraints or acceptance assertions.
Break execution into atomic tasks with exact inputs, paths/components, state transition, required behavior, tests/evidence and done conditions; serialize only shared/colliding owners.

Writer packets should be executable by capable ordinary ChatGPT chats, not depend on Work-scale context or hidden memory. Heavy Work is reserved for synthesis/research/complex integration, while writer capsules remain compact and deterministic.
A writer may identify contradictions but must not silently reinterpret the product. It records the conflict and applies the packet precedence/supersession rules.
Packets include what must not change, what must not be duplicated, forbidden state owners, forbidden shortcuts and known traps, not only desired features.
Material interaction states use explicit transition tables/Given-When-Then assertions rather than relying on narrative interpretation.
Production writer is an implementer, not a second product designer. Conversion packets map frozen Blueprint behavior into current code with explicit allowed implementation freedom.
Every Owner requirement/capability/command/state maps through Blueprint component to production symbol/test/evidence or explicit disposition.
Production conversion packets include exact current branch/SHA, paths/symbols, owners, adapters, route/data contracts, test targets, collision map and write scope.
Production parity must cover visual hierarchy, behavior, state semantics, keyboard/pointer, accessibility, responsive, themes/Bidi, error/empty states and domain truth.

Owner examples are minimum evidence, not an exhaustive list. Big Boss must systematically search for analogous states/use cases and improve the doctrine without deleting or weakening direct Owner intent.
For each proposed universal rule, test it against modal/persistent/transient/editor/spatial/table/operational/review/configuration archetypes to avoid overgeneralization.

Big Boss must actively search current authority/blueprints/product for unnecessary locks, read-only assumptions, single-route interactions, duplicate settings owners and donor regressions, not wait for the Owner to point them out.
Big Boss must actively identify strong mechanics in existing donors/production/historical work that should be preserved or generalized, even if they were not mentioned in current Owner examples.
Product language is configurable, never permanently Arabic-first.
UI language and language pack are separate preferences.
Chrome direction can AUTO/LTR/RTL independently of locale.
Natural language direction is separate from chrome direction.
Alignment START/END/LEFT/RIGHT/CENTER/JUSTIFY is independently applicable.
Typography and script fallback are separate from language.
Technical tokens retain logical byte/codepoint sequence; canonical metadata has its own edit command.
One global semantic preference owner.
Safe default→global→workspace→surface→view/tool→valid content/object→session.
Global ownership is not globally forced value.
Mixed-script and terminal/code presentation need explicit profiles.
Presentation changes never implicitly rewrite canonical content metadata.
Many settings entry routes use one preference registry.
UI preferences remain distinct from W05 operational configuration.
Context budget is governed; Reader Set first and exact lookup only.
W02 Library/Editor and Visualize are high-value mechanical donor floors; reuse compatible generic mechanics without importing foreign business/domain truth.
The W03 world-class proposal is high-value design input, not frozen authority or automatic acceptance.
W03 may improve beyond its proposal while preserving underlying professional needs and semantic boundaries.
Controller/Writer lineage packets are evidence/reconstruction inputs; recency alone never grants acceptance.
Context budget is architectural: use decision-complete capsules/indices first and exact raw lookup only for named conflicts, identities or proof gaps.

For compatible generic workspace/presentation/interaction mechanics, exact Accepted Library v1.2.17 executable donor code is the primary design donor; crosswalks summarize but do not replace donor inspection.
Preserve before invent: REUSE_AS_IS > REUSE_VISUALLY_AS_IS > ADAPT_DOMAIN_ONLY > EXTEND_WITHOUT_REPLACING > NEW_DESIGN_ONLY_IF_INCOMPATIBILITY_IS_EXPLICITLY_PROVEN.

Cross-surface CEP continuity is required: compatible generic pane/context-menu/transient/settings/responsive/command-discovery/focus grammar remains recognizably Library-lineage while domain content/actions adapt above it.
Across ALL CEP workspaces/surfaces, optional guidance/support UI such as legends, guiding labels, stickers/chips, hints, badges, callouts and helper overlays is not permanent forced chrome.

Eligible guidance UI exposes applicable show/hide, open/close/reopen, move/reposition or dock/anchor, persistence/reset and keyboard-accessible recovery; preferred state remains distinct from responsive effective state.
Guidance customization never hides mandatory safety/security/authority/integrity/legal/error/accessibility truth; split optional guidance from mandatory disclosure when mixed.

Applicable spatial default input profile: blank LEFT-drag marquee; object LEFT-drag move; RIGHT-click context; Space+LEFT-drag temporary pan; middle-drag pan; wheel vertical pan/scroll; Shift+wheel horizontal; Ctrl/Cmd+wheel pointer-centered zoom; fit/zoom routes stay keyboard reachable.

Applicable spatial multi-selection/context routes use one semantic command owner and Library-derived professional contextual/transient grammar; spatial selection/geometry never becomes domain truth by itself.

Customization is a general platform principle, not a language-only exception. Theme, language, direction, alignment, layout, pane widths/visibility, toolbar composition, guidance, editor/spatial presentation and other safe presentation/workspace preferences should be configurable where meaningful.
